title: Kettu-Vellam

source_analysis.finding: Page title and headers identify Kettu-Vellam as a Kerala snake boat (chundan vallam) racing game

Meta description describes a free 3D browser boat racing game: race chundan vallam snake boats through Punnamada Lake, Kuttanad canals, and a monsoon storm on Vembanad, with rival crews, live leaderboards, crowd atmosphere and rhythmic vanchipattu
Embedded JSON-LD types the page as schema.org VideoGame named Kettu-Vellam, genres Racing and Sports, gamePlatform Web browser, applicationCategory Game, playMode SinglePlayer, free offer
Root page renders a GameLoader client component with a 'Launching onto the backwaters' loading screen, showing the root URL is the playable game entry, not just a promotional page
Web manifest sets name Kettu-Vellam, display fullscreen, orientation landscape, start_url /, categories games/sports/entertainment, confirming an installable browser game shell
HTML head declares generator v0.app and Next.js/Turbopack _next/static chunks, establishing the site framework and build tool

Public GitHub repository search for kettuvellam returns zero results, so no verified related source repository is established; an unrelated HTML5 Canvas vallam-kali-browser-game exists but shares no verified identity, playable URL, or project reference with this site
The only inspectable image (og-image.jpg) is a cinematic golden-hour photo of a snake boat crew with crowds and palms, presented as og:image/social banner, not as labeled in-engine gameplay
Sitemap contains only the root URL, last modified 2026-09-26, with no separate play, docs, or screenshot gallery pages found

No explicit keyboard/mouse, touch joystick, gamepad, or motion-control documentation was found in the inspected static page, manifest, or metadata; viewport and fullscreen PWA settings alone do not establish touch controls

screenshots.observation: Inspected 1200x630 social banner: photorealistic/cinematic side view of a black chundan vallam with gold prow ornament carrying a long crew of rowers mid-stroke, water spray, palm trees, sunset clouds, and bank crowds. Curated promotional reference image, not verifiable in-game 3D runtime output; no HUD, boat physics, or gameplay state visible.

reconstructed_prompt: Build Kettu-Vellam, a free 3D browser snake-boat racing game about Kerala vallam kali: race chundan vallam boats across Punnamada Lake, narrow Kuttanad canals, and a Vembanad monsoon-storm course, with rival crews, live leaderboards, bank crowds, and rhythmic vanchipattu music, as a fullscreen landscape Next.js web app with a GameLoader entry.
how_to_play: Open https://kettuvellam.com in a web browser and wait past the Launching onto the backwaters loader into the GameLoader client
Select a race course when offered: Punnamada Lake, Kuttanad canals, or the Vembanad monsoon-storm course
Race a chundan vallam snake boat against rival crews to the finish line
Check the live leaderboard for race results
mechanics: Chundan vallam snake-boat racing on Kerala backwater courses
Three advertised locales: Punnamada Lake, Kuttanad canals, Vembanad monsoon storm
Crowd atmosphere and rhythmic vanchipattu presentation

rating.reason: Excluding the target, closest comparators are Kart Royale (50, complete browser 3D racer with verified kart physics, AI field, and two inspected gameplay frames), Turbo Kart Rally (40, browser kart racer with inspected 3D frames), Sakura Rally (56, deeper rally package with custom physics and campaign but no web play), and Infinite Craft (52, no-source browser game with inspected UI). Kettu-Vellam has a live fullscreen browser game entry, PWA shell, three advertised courses, rival crews, and leaderboards, which suggests broader racing scope than single-track demos, but with zero inspectable in-engine gameplay screenshots, no verified repository, no documented controls, and no verifiable physics, audio, performance, or balance evidence, it cannot match Sakura Rally or Kart Royale on verified technical execution and sits just below Infinite Craft/Kart Royale, above arcade-minimal catalog entries.
